description: This file handles Feishu card actions, including token management, event processing, and command dispatching within a Feishu integration module.

methods.name: resetProcessedFeishuCardActionTokensForTests
methods.description: Resets the in-memory token processing state, primarily for testing purposes.

methods.name: pruneProcessedCardActionTokens
methods.description: Removes expired tokens from the in-memory store.

methods.name: beginFeishuCardActionToken
methods.description: Claims a token for processing if not already claimed or expired.

methods.name: completeFeishuCardActionToken
methods.description: Marks a token as completed in the in-memory store.

methods.name: releaseFeishuCardActionToken
methods.description: Releases a token, removing it from the in-memory store.

methods.name: buildSyntheticMessageEvent
methods.description: Constructs a synthetic Feishu message event from a card action event.

methods.name: resolveCallbackTarget
methods.description: Determines whether to send a response to a chat or user based on event context.

methods.name: dispatchSyntheticCommand
methods.description: Dispatches a command as a synthetic message in Feishu.

methods.name: sendInvalidInteractionNotice
methods.description: Sends a notice message indicating an invalid or stale card interaction.

methods.name: handleFeishuCardAction
methods.description: Main handler for processing a Feishu card action event, including validation, decoding, and command execution.
